lines.zh: 缓慢挪动，腐烂之躯在移动。
lines.en: Slowly shuffles, rotting flesh moves.

lines.zh: 步履蹒跚，腐烂的肌肉在挣扎。
lines.en: Lurches, rotting muscles struggle.
Slowly ambles forward.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手臂艰难地移动。
lines.en: Rotting arms move艰难地.
Rotting muscles struggle to move.
Slowly moves forward.
Rotting fingers feel about.
Rotting muscles struggle.
Heels scraping the ground, I shuffle forward.
One leg stiff, I move very slowly.
My shoulder knocks aside the low branches.

lines.zh: 顺着血腥味走过碎石路。
lines.en: I follow the smell of blood across the gravel.

lines.zh: 低头凝视着空洞的眼窝。
lines.en: Looks down at hollow sockets.
Stares blankly ahead.
Sways aimlessly.
Empty eyes stare.
Sways back and forth slowly.
Wanders aimlessly.

lines.zh: 空洞的眼窝盯着地平线。
lines.en: Hollow sockets stare at the horizon.
Sways slowly.
Empty eyeballs stare.
Stares unseeing.
Notices player, slowly moves.
Notices player, slowly advances.
Fixes on player, slowly moves.
Stares at player, slowly approaches.

lines.zh: 注意到了玩家，缓缓逼近。
lines.en: Notices player, slowly approaches.
Stares at player, slowly moves.

lines.zh: 我隔着栅栏看你，没停脚。
lines.en: I watch you through the fence without stopping.
Stares at player, slowly advances.
Fixes on player, slowly approaches.

lines.zh: 灰白的眼睛慢慢对准你。
lines.en: My grey eyes slowly settle on you.
Rotten skin, excruciating pain.
Wounds tearing, bleeding non-stop.

lines.zh: 肩上的肉掉了一块，没感觉。
lines.en: A chunk of shoulder falls away; I feel nothing.
Torn flesh.
Rotten limb.
In unbearable pain.
Rotten flesh dripping.
Rotten wound.
Rotten tendon.
A chunk of rot falls off. It hurts.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指在腐肉上蠕动，逼近美味的人肉。
lines.en: Rotting fingers crawl towards the delicious human flesh.

lines.zh: 闻着你的恐惧，我将享受盛宴。
lines.en: Feast on your fear, I will.

lines.zh: 尝尝末地的美味，你会爱上它的。
lines.en: Try the deliciousness of the Nether, you'll love it.

lines.zh: 饥饿的触手蠢蠢欲动，寻找新的宿主。
lines.en: Hungry tentacles yearn for new hosts.

lines.zh: 腐朽的躯壳渴望着新鲜的生命。
lines.en: Decaying flesh craves fresh life.

lines.zh: 咬下一块肉，品尝我的力量。
lines.en: Taste my strength with a bite of flesh.

lines.zh: 血液的味道如此甜美，让我贪婪。
lines.en: How sweet the blood tastes, it makes me greedy.

lines.zh: 猎物就在眼前，无法逃脱我的抓握。
lines.en: The prey is in sight, none can escape my grasp.

lines.zh: 腐烂的心脏跳动着，发出最后的哀鸣。
lines.en: The rotting heart beats, issuing its final cry.

lines.zh: 贪婪吞噬着我的意志，只有肉才是真实的。
lines.en: Greed consumes my will, only flesh is real.

lines.zh: 轰隆一声，你撞上了我的存在。
lines.en: Boom! You collided with me.

lines.zh: 碰撞激起的尘土，遮蔽了我的视线。
lines.en: Dust from the collision obscures my vision.

lines.zh: 你这愚蠢的行为让我愤怒，我将碾碎你。
lines.en: Foolish, your actions anger me; I'll crush you.

lines.zh: 触碰我，你将尝到末地的痛苦。
lines.en: Touch me, and feel the Nether's pain.

lines.zh: 坚硬的骨头在我脚下碎裂。
lines.en: Hard bones shatter under my feet.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是我的身体，痛苦将随之而来。
lines.en: You hit my body, and pain will follow.

lines.zh: 碰撞无法改变什么，你终将被吞噬。
lines.en: Collision changes nothing, you will be devoured.
Boom! You collided with me.

lines.zh: 坚硬的盔甲也无法阻挡我的冲击。
lines.en: Even your armor cannot stop my impact.

lines.zh: 你与我相撞，无法逃脱我的束缚。
lines.en: You collided with me, you cannot escape my hold.

lines.zh: 我寻找着伴侣，共同繁衍。
lines.en: I seek a mate, to breed together.

lines.zh: 末世的孤独，只有同类可以填补。
lines.en: The loneliness of the wasteland, only a mate can fill it.

lines.zh: 找一个伴侣，延续我们的血脉。
lines.en: Find a mate, to continue our line.

lines.zh: 我们一同前行，找到另一个行尸。
lines.en: We travel together, seeking another Walker.

lines.zh: 在末世中，我们互相依靠。
lines.en: In the wasteland, we rely on each other.

lines.zh: 寻找一个伴侣，共同面对末日。
lines.en: Find a mate to face the end together.

lines.zh: 孤独的行尸，渴望着伴侣的到来。
lines.en: The lonely Walker, yearns for a mate.

lines.zh: 我们是同类，注定要互相寻找。
lines.en: We are of the same kind, destined to find each other.

lines.zh: 寻找一个伙伴，共同抵抗末日。
lines.en: Find a partner to resist the end with us.

lines.zh: 在末世中，只有彼此可以依靠。
lines.en: In the wasteland, only each other can be relied upon.
Cold skin feels like decay.
Wounds ooze brown pus.
Joints creak loudly.
Rotting hair sways in the breeze.
I crouch to gnaw something swallowable.
Bite marks on bones.
Rotten sound like a wail.

lines.zh: 断掉的腿骨发出咔嚓声。
lines.en: Cracking sound from broken leg bones.
Squeaking from wounds.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肌肉发出腥臭味。
lines.en: Rotten flesh gives off a foul smell.
Notices the target's movement.
Targets a living person.
Dragging each step, but the direction is right.
Approaches the target.
Drag step after drag step, but never off course.
Arms raised, I walk toward you.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，闻到了活人气。
lines.en: I lift my head and smell a living human.

lines.zh: 我的手指先动，腿才跟上。
lines.en: My fingers move first; my legs follow.
I smell the sweat under your armor.
Steadies its gaze on the prey.
Something alive is moving over there.
The smell of blood drifts from your way.
One that is still breathing.
I hear your footsteps.
Easy now; do not startle it.
Bites the target tightly.
Chews on the prey.
Tears off the prey's leg.
Grabs the prey's flesh.
Tears the prey apart with its teeth.
Tearing the prey with its claws.
Sucks the prey's blood.
Bites on the prey's bones.
Tearing the prey's clothes.
Bites the target tightly.
Step by step, I come closer.

lines.zh: 你的背贴上了砖，我不急了。
lines.en: Your back meets the brick; I take my time.

lines.zh: 咬一口，你就得跟着我们。
lines.en: One bite, and you join us.
That wound will not heal on its own.
Your leg will break first.
I am in no hurry; you cannot outrun me.
My hands rise for your collar.
Blood drips on the ground, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，你动了，我要吃了你！
lines.en: Sssss, you move. I’m going to eat you!
Bite, bite, you can’t escape!

lines.zh: 你闻到了吗？我的味道不错！
lines.en: You can smell me, right? I taste good.
I won’t let you go easily!
The pain won’t last long!
You struggle in my mouth!
Eat, this is your destiny!
Don’t move, I’m enjoying you!

lines.zh: 你已经没有反抗之力了！
lines.en: You have no strength to resist!

lines.zh: 吞噬你，这就是我的存在！
lines.en: Devour you, that’s my existence!
My teeth sink into your arm.
My nails open a long gash.
I press my whole weight onto you.
One bite takes sleeve and flesh.

lines.zh: 腐臭的呼吸喷在你脸上。
lines.en: My rotten breath hits your face.
You stagger back three steps.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，一个行尸出现了！
lines.en: A Walker appeared in the darkness!
A new Walker joins the End!
A Walker emerges from the ruins!

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在黑暗中闪烁！
lines.en: Its eyes glow in the darkness!
A Walker roams at night!
Another Walker appears in the End!

lines.zh: 废墟的墙缝里，我钻出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the cracks in these ruins.
It hunts for new prey!
A Walker moves in the shadows!
One stands up in the ruin's doorway.
I crawl out from under an overturned cart.
The turning is done; it opens its eyes.
The night wind blows this way.

lines.zh: 墙后传来拖行的脚步声。
lines.en: A dragging step sounds behind the wall.
Burned by fire.
Fell from height.

lines.zh: 积水灌进肺里，我早不呼吸了。
lines.en: Water fills my lungs, though I stopped breathing long ago.
Blasted by explosion.

lines.zh: 箭头卡在我锁骨上，拔不掉。
lines.en: The arrowhead sticks in my collarbone.
Burned by magic.
I am so hungry my bones poke through.
Lightning strike.
Died in the void.
